## Yuyake 0.0.2
### Changed
- The last setup screen now says Yuyake starts when you log in, and that Settings can turn that off
### Fixed
- Removing Yuyake's lock screen copies, and tidying the wallpaper catalog, now leave alone any custom wallpaper entry that is not Yuyake's - Weather and sunrise lookups send your location rounded to about a kilometre, as the privacy text says - Copy Diagnostics also hides media file names that were logged without quotes - Downloads refuse redirects to non-https or local-network addresses, and the Discover server can no longer point Yuyake at them
### Learn more
https://pennowick.com/yuyake/
Full changelog: https://github.com/yuyakeapp/yuyake-releases/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

## Yuyake 0.0.1
### Added
- Live video wallpaper on your desktop and, optionally, your lock screen - A built-in Discover library, plus your own clips and photo slideshows - Schedules, Auto, rotation and collections, with no limits - Quitting Yuyake leaves your macOS wallpaper as it was, and Settings has a Restore macOS wallpaper button - Help menu: Send Feedback and Copy Diagnostics, sent only if you choose - Privacy text that lists every connection Yuyake makes
### Learn more
https://pennowick.com/yuyake/
Full changelog: https://github.com/yuyakeapp/yuyake-releases/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
